status: Written before a single waitlist answer was counted. The numbers below are fixed in advance so they cannot be loosened once real counts tempt us to publish early. A change needs a new dated file and a line in design.ko.md saying why.
what_it_is: Share of people on the AFMX waitlist (later: paying members) who asked for alerts on a sector or stock. These people chose to sign up; they are not a sample of individual investors. It shows what they watch, not what they fear, and not what anyone should buy or sell.

stage_0.name: Internal only
stage_0.use: Decide which sectors and stocks get cards and alerts first. Nothing is published, not even the number of people.

stage_1.name: Static table: what members watch
never_published: picks by language unless each language has 100 people

stage_2.name: A series over time that may be called an index
stage_2.counts_only: paying members with an active membership
stage_2.baseline: Sector shares of the same picks one year earlier once that exists; before that, each sector's count of S&P 500 member companies. If the rank correlation is at or above the limit, the series says nothing the baseline does not, and it stays a table.

stop.rule: If stage 1 has not been reached by this date, the public version is dropped and the count stays internal. No lowering of min_people.
